qa.text: Ribosomes are the cell's protein factories. They read messenger RNA and join amino acids into a chain. Ribosomes are found free in the cytoplasm or attached to the rough endoplasmic reticulum.
qa.cards:
What do ribosomes make? | Proteins
What do ribosomes read? | Messenger RNA
Where are ribosomes found? | Free in the cytoplasm or on the rough endoplasmic reticulum
